question: Which launch vehicle did the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) use for its 100th launch from Satish Dhawan Space Centre in Sriharikota in January 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**GSLV-F15**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **ISRO** achieved its historic **100th launch** from the **Satish Dhawan Space Centre (SDSC), Sriharikota** in **January 2025** using the launch vehicle **GSLV-F15**, carrying the navigation satellite **NVS-02** to a **Geosynchronous Transfer Orbit (GTO)**.
